reviews.text:
Made us feel very comfortable that Dax (our kitten) was being taken care of by offering proactive options for his long term health.

Very friendly staff overall.
very helpful
Thank you for taking good care of, always being friendly humble professional and spoiling my little golden ! Very happy and secure with Greenwood
the staff was professional very supportive kind and gentle very knowledgeable compassionate excellent people
We travel all the way from the West End so our cats can be treated by Dr. Marcus Luckwald. Best vet in town!

I feel so fortunate to have found this extremely compassionate team at Greenwood Park Animal Hospital. I had a senior bunny, Gobi, who had age-related complications that other clinics had misdiagnosed.

The doctors here are very competent and knowledgeable. At the very first visit, doctor diagnosed him and started the treatment  right away which helped my bunny tremendously. I was so relieved that my money was well-spent here.

The front desk staff and techs are also extremely ethical and helpful. One time I was worried about my bunny's arthritic paws and wanted to visit but the staff asked me to send pictures over the email and told me to watch and wait unlike other clinics that book unnecessarily for benign things regardless of animal's discomfort.

I was especially impressed with the team with my recent experience when my bunny got critically ill. I was on a financial crunch and the entire team was extremely considerate of my situation. They kept me informed of the expenses at every step while caring for my bunny. The doctor was extremely empathic and caring. They gave me multiple discounts considering the urgency of my situation. I was accommodated at every step and overall, I had a very positive experience. It felt like I was among my family who were aware and supportive of my emotional crisis.

A few kind-hearted people on earth have found each other at Greenwood Park Animal Hospital. Their team is highly professional and ethical. I respect these people from the bottom of my heart for providing care for vulnerable animals. I highly recommend others to seek help from them when in need for their  pets.

Here is a photo of my deceased bunny who took a piece of my heart and left this world.
I was able to get an appointment quickly.  I particularly appreciated how attentive, helpful and encouraging Dr. Markus Luckwaldt was. My turtle and I had the most positive experience possible!
Dr. Luckwaldt is an amazing doctor for all types of animals. I would recommend him for anyone who has exotic animals. The staff is great and I couldn't ask for a better vet.
The team at Greenwood Park has always been so supportive and caring for our cats. They are so helpful and have been able to accommodate us quickly for urgent needs as well as regular check ins.

An absolute five-star experience! After 30 years of caring for small animals, we can easily tell Dr. Amanda really knows her stuff, and she explained everything in a way that truly resonated with us. A special shoutout to Nicky, who immediately put our nervous energy at ease and made us feel so welcome. You are officially our one and only vet—we will definitely be back!

Some people get into a profession because of the money or prestige, or due to family pressure... for others it's a true calling. For Dr. Amanda, it's very clearly the latter. My American Bully XL Boxer Cross fell in love with her immediately, and so did I. In fact, the whole staff, the environment, and even surrounding clientele added to the comfort level. The scale had padding instead of that cold, slippery steel; the table flipped up/had hydraulics so my majestic beast could stay comfortably on the floor; they adjusted appointment times to suit my sleep disorder and so that he could have his booster and de-balling in the same afternoon,... I mean..C'mon! They were ROCKSTARS!! Could NOT have asked for better and KINDER people caring for my baby!! Will keep everyone posted!!
The starr took so much care for my beautiful hamster Violet
Excellent care and attentive to the needs of Gizmo.

Update:  The animal I took into Greenwood Park that was critically ill and they turned down treatment, died, and I blame them to a degree for turning down an emergency with no remorse or empathy.  I had been going there for several years and they could not muster the humanity to fit him in  for an emergency forcing a delay in treatment that could have saved my animals life.    Going to Greenwood Park Animal hospital us my greatest regret.  They do the bare minimum, never follow through on promises they make and turn down dying animals on the spot without a care.  If you love your animal find someone who has a passion for this work because there is no one at Greenwood Park that does or cares.  Like I said we went there for years, paid our bills on the spot and we were told by Dr. Markus he see emergencies.  It was all nonsense and lies.

Thank you everyone for the love and prayers.  The Reptile that passed was Link.  He was real special in that he wasn't long for this world when I got him.  He had a real curiosity from the start.  On the way home he climbed to the top of the box and was looking around and out the windows back at me with such enthusiasm.  I bonded with him immediately.  And he was a constant companion in the mornimg while  I had coffee and began work.  He inspired me to take in more damaged reptiles the highlight was a chameleon we named Leon.  He was severely burned.  The bony spine that protruded from his back was burned right off and his sides and arms were burned so bad his pincer like hands could no longer grip anything.  Man I miss them all

From the reception to the tech and the vet, everybody was lovely. They all exhibited genuine interest in the wellbeing of all animals that walked through their door. They were quick to offer professional and personal insight regarding any questions I had. I would easily recommend this location to anybody who is in need of a caring veterinarian. Thank you for taking good care of Tiramisu.
We felt very comfortable with the staff, and they treated our little guy perfectly.

The absolute best for exotics within the GTA! Dr. Luckwaldt is one of the best! I worked with him 20+ years ago and he was just as fabulous back then.
The had the recent experience of seeing a vet who was filling in for Dr. Luckwaldt, this vet was very thorough and explained everything well. All staff are extremely caring and you feel the love they have for all animals. Thank you Greenwood!
Additionally, prices are fair. 100% recommend.

I’ve had nothing but great experiences at Greenwood Park Animal Hospital. All of the doctors are incredibly caring, and every staff member is kind and welcoming. What I appreciate most is that they always explain everything in a way that’s easy to understand. I never leave feeling confused about my pet’s care or what I’m paying for, and I always feel like they take the time to answer my questions. Highly recommend!
Highly recommend and trust this vet clinic. Exceptionally trust worthy and skilled staff

Booked me and my little gecko 2 days within calling, took care in handling him and did so very quickly!

Staff is very friendly and went the extra mile to send me some information on dietary/husbandry, to further help my understanding of what my little guy might need.

Really appreciate the kindness and care of our first visit!
We have always received great care from all the employees ranging from front desk, to vet technicians and DVMs.  They all go over and above to make your experience a good one.
Great professional care!
Dr Markus was very patient answering all my questions, can’t ask for a better help team like Jem and other techs!
Great service.  They really care about the animals (and their humans).

Our Gracie has been cared for at Greenwood Park Animal Hospital for almost 12 years. The staff are caring and compassionate. Dr. Luckwaldt is very patient with Gracie as she gets agitated when  in the hospital. His diagnoses are usually correct and he never pressures us into tests we don’t need for Gracie. You can trust him to tell you the truth and to provide the best care for your furry family member.

We always appreciate the effort and care that Greenwood Park animal hospital takes with our cats. We have brought 4 of our cats here over the years and we have been taken good care of each time.

I would appreciate more guidance with our senior animals, such as recommending more regular blood tests. This was one thing we felt was missing from previous visits where we may have been able to detect our cat's cancer earlier. We understand it's not in everyone's budget and the hospital doesn't want to push costs on folks, which I greatly appreciate, but letting people make their own decision by sharing an informed perspective for pet owners is something we would appreciate.

10/10 recommend this clinic for top tier, compassionate, and knowledgeable rabbit health care! The RVT's and Dr were so incredibly helpful while Marble was dealing with suspected GI stasis. They provide ample education about ideal care and lifestyle recommendations! Not only did the treat my girl in the most gentle and kind manner, but they were very helpful in ensuring I could afford everything with a payment plan. I see some reviews about wait-times, and while I understand it can be frustrating to wait, I think their drive to treat as many furry friends as possible speaks to their big hearts! Thank you SO much Greenwood Park for getting Miss Marble back to her spunky self, we'll see you for a check up at the end of the year! 🫶🏼

Dr. Luckwaldt & Tara are amazing!  They took such good care of our little Ellie-Beans. They are personable, take their time explaining things, and it's very clear that they care deeply about animals.  I would highly recommend them to anyone for their bunny!  Thank you all so much :)

Greenwood park Animal Hospital has provided care for years for our so far pet fancy rats. They are well informed vets who care even about the smallest animals. I have learnt so much about my pets through them. Highly recommend their services.

I’ve been a client at Greenwood Park Animal Hospital for nearly 15 years, and have brought 4 different dogs of mine there over that time. The staff are amazing, caring, knowledgeable and passionate about their work. They’ve been great with dogs of all temperaments that I’ve owned, and have always provided the most exceptional care to my pets.
Despite moving slightly further away, I continue to return to Greenwood Park because of the staff and care provided. I can’t recommend them enough and expect to stay with them as long as my dogs are around
I bring my dog, canary and tortoise here and have had great experiences with everyone. No frills, just great service and caring staff.

if you're below the poverty line like myself, they have always been kind and understanding of my situation. they were always so lovely and caring with my rats in the past and are the same with my rabbit currently 😊! can't recommend them enough. …
Luv this place. Staff are amazing and most importantly my pups are well taken care of and always running to their door when we arrive….now that says something🐶💖 …
The Staff is always very good with our rescue dog who can be a bit skittish especially when being held for shots. Everyone is very kind and knowledgeable. Highly recommended
You guys were super friendly, knowledgeable and affordable! So glad my rabbit was in such good gands
Excellent care for our lovely bird, highly recommend! ♥️ And to add to this, huge thanks and shout out to Emma for her awesome professionalism and help, we are so grateful! 🤗 …
Caring and animal loving veterinary hospital clinic. They have taken care of my dog most of her life. They always have time to fit you in an emergency situation as well.

My experience with Greenwood park vet clinic  is amazing they are the closest clinic that deal with birds and other small animals  most vets deal only with dogs and cats this vet deals with all small animals like rabbits birds rats and other creatures.

Exotics owners, this is the best exotics vet in the GTA. We make the hour drive from the west end because we know our ratties are in the best hands with Dr. Luckwaldt and his team. They have helped our silly gals out of so many predicaments. Thank you Greenwood Park!!

I brought my pet ball python here for a thermal burn, and the care he received was phenomenal. Everyone on staff, from the reception team to vet techs to veterinarians, were so kind and helpful and calming in such a stressful situation.

Teddy and I are so grateful to the Greenwood Park Animal Hospital team! <3
The wait time is usually over 30-45mins for every appointment. The doctors keep changing which isn’t the best.
Thank God for Greenwood.  Their team has given superb care to my little ones over the last ten years.  I would send any rat or rabbit folk there with full confidence.
First thing it was easy, caring for my precious rabbit by Greenwood Park was professional and options were given to me. Great place for animal care.
Apart from the wait time everything is excellent. The place is simple and cozy and everyone is super nice and helpful. I got answers for all my questions. Thank you so much!

I had a wonderful experience here with them treating my gerbil for a broken leg.
The whole atmosphere of the office was friendly and welcoming, as were each member of staff I interacted with. The vet and vet tech’s love of animals was clear and very reassuring as they examined my gerbil. They were thoughtful, gentle, and patient with him, and it put me immediately at ease. I was also reassured by how much they knew about gerbils and was confident in trusting their recommendations for a treatment plan.
Thank you for treating Jerry and I so well!
Staff was friendly,  knowledgeable and above all, empathetic
Have been coming here for years for our rabbits. They are always great
The most knowledgeable small pet and rabbit vet we've ever met. I wouldn't take my bunnies anywhere else.
Wonderful staff ...friendly and professional

You were kind, caring, and looked after my dog (and my worry) despite me not having an appointment nor my dog being one of your regular patients.  I have now registered to become a regular! Thank you.
Amazing team that was super helpful with our Leopard Gecko who had an eye issue. 10/10!

I think all of the vets and vet techs there are very caring people. I’ve been to one vet where it was clear they cared more about money than the animals and it’s very clear that Greenwood puts the animals health first. They explain everything thoroughly. Their prices are still as reasonable as possible. I feel like it’s a place with a lot of really lovely people and I appreciate everything they do for Willow, Mimi and Abby.

I recently switched my cat to Greenwood after moving and being unhappy with the service provided by her previous vet clinic.

Immediately on our first visit there Jadena was calmer then she had ever been at her previous clinic ,the staff were welcoming and friendly and there was no waiting no oops messed up your appointment time - we were seen right away. The team was patient with her and for the first time at the vet , she wasn't hissing or freaking out .

At my old clinic if I had to call with a question I would sometimes wait days for a call back , sometimes that never came. This morning I had to call and Greenwood said , no worries let me ask a doctor right now.

I had Greenwood refered to me by two friends and am so happy I found your team. Thank you for the excellent customer service off the bat
Fantastic knowledge, care and attention for our pet rabbit. Would definitely return and recommend!

Greenwood vet is the best! Dr. Luckwaldt is such a great veterinarian who is so knowledgeable and wonderful to work with. I’m so happy that I went here when my dog Lola was sick. Thank you Greenwood vet.

Staff and vets are kind, caring, and knowledgable, and go out of their way to be helpful.  However, it would be nice to have the same doctor assigned to a pet, rather than a different member of the team each time.
Dr. Adrienne was excellent. Went above and beyond call of duty to assist us with a diagnosis. Staff is friendly and knowledgeable for a busy clinic. Fully recommend.

Best Avian Care in Toronto and we’ve tried them all over 30+ years. It’s now rare to find someone still passionate about birds instead of them being an add-on just lumped in with”Exotics” as an afterthought. We are thrilled!

I’m so grateful yo Dr. Markus and his wonderful team care for everything animal with so much love and respect. Their compassion goes beyond medicine. They truly understand how pets become part of our families.

Sharing this photo of the Day of the Dead altar as a small tribute to the love we have for our pets, it was pretty special to see.

❤️❤️❤️Top-Notch Professionalism for International Pet Travel❤️❤️❤️

A stellar experience with Emma and Dr. Luckwaldt. We required international health certificates for our birds, and their service was exceptional. The entire process was handled with maximum efficiency and professionalism. Emma was friendly and ensured all documentation was perfectly in order, while Dr. Luckwaldt provided knowledgeable and thorough care for our birds. I am deeply impressed with their expertise and highly recommend them for any complex veterinary needs, especially international travel.
Thanks for helping me put down my hamster. So he doesn’t suffering anymore.

Huge thank you to Greenwood Park for giving us a last minute appointment for out little schnauzer Frankie.  Incredible staff and
Dr. Luckwaldt is amazing. We highly recommend this amazing hospital.

Absolutely fantastic clinic. Amazing vets and staff. Knowledgeable. Exceptionally caring. My previous dog became suddenly ill with a tumor. Dr. Marcus Went well beyond what I expected in supporting both my dog and myself. He referred me to a fantastic specialist, but after much care she What is two unwell to continue care. He allowed me to bring my dog back to His clinic and allowed me to sit with her as long as I needed while she passed. I am forever grateful

The best veterinary experience we’ve ever had!
From the moment we walked in, the service was incredibly kind and professional. The team truly cares about the well-being of pets, and you can see it in every detail: their patience, dedication, and the way they explain everything so you feel at ease.

Both my dog and my cat were treated with so much love, as if they were their own, and that makes all the difference. The clinic is very clean, organized, and fully equipped. On top of that, the prices are very fair for the exceptional level of care they provide.

I completely recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone who wants their pets to receive the best care. You can truly feel the passion and love for animals in everything they do! 💖🐾
Love the vets, technicians and admin staff here - they are so helpful. We have been bringing our two cats here for 10 years.

I took my hamster here to have her nails trimmed. Everyone is friendly, respectful and kind. Dr.  DiDonato met with me to give me an update. Tara and Dr. DiDonato presented me with ideas to keep my hamster's nails worn down in her enclosure, which I appreciate!

Dr. Amanda and vet tech Jem were incredible! I brought my turtle in for an appointment and they both were helpful, kind, and knowledgable. They took the time to give me advice, answer any questions I had, and even sent a follow up email with all the info we spoke about in the appointment. This was my first vet appointment so I didn't know what to expect but I am so pleasantly surprised. I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Amanda!

Recently my dog looked at me and I could tell that something was wrong. When I tried to pick him up he cried out in pain and I knew it was serious. I called Greenwood Park animal Hospital because a friend of mine had told me of his good experience there. Although they were fully booked for the day they put me on hold for a couple of minutes and were able to get me an emergency appointment within a few hours of my call.  I am ever grateful for their kind and compassionate care in helping me with my dog.
I highly recommend them.
Super friendly staff who care and take their time with our precious boy.
Marcus, I found to be a compassionate Veterinarian.
Good vets. They communicate well. Excellent care

I was going to my previous vet for close to 15 years. When I heard they weren’t servicing exotic animals anymore it definitely put me in a bit of a bind and I was concerned. They recommended Greenwood Park Animal Hospital and all of my concerns have been put to rest.

Everyone one was super professional and knowledgeable, and I know Tommy will be in good hands moving forward. If you have a pet and are looking for a new vet I would totally recommended Greenwood Park Animal Hospital.

Our cat was limping due to an unknown injury incurred on one of her overnight 'patrols'. Greenwood Park Animal Hospital  did a terrific job with a cautious and careful approach to treating her, and she’s good as new now. Thanks!

I have trusted Greenwood Park Animal Hospital to care for our cats for more than a decade and have had only fantastic care. Booking appointments is easy and often available on short notice when it matters.  I appreciate the follow up phone calls / emails after a visit to see how our cat is doing after a health scare has been treated.  The whole team here leaves me feeling confident in managing my cat's health.

apparently they forgot charge me for 2 test my dog had on the 14th of April. No one called me to tell me, I was in last week to reschedule, (two weeks after the first he initial appointment) nothing was said, nothing on the app. I went back today for a follow up. Then add it to my bill and don’t say anything until I went pay and I noticed my bill was over $100 what it should have been and I asked about it.

I feel very taken advantage of by this place, every time I go,

I've been with Greenwood Park Animal Hospital for almost 10 years, and I couldn't ask for better care. Dr. Amanda is fantastic! - she always takes the time to answer all my questions and provides thoughtful advice and exceptional care for my dog, especially as he gets older.
We are so grateful for their thorough care for our elderly cat.  The front staff are friendly and welcoming.  Our vet and the vet techs have provided great attention.  Highly recommend

It was our first visit to this vet as our regular vet does not treat bunnies. The staff were professional. Dr. Luckwaldt was thorough and kind. Without having to ask he checked to see if Potato (our rescue albino rabbit) had a chip, trimmed his claws and sent me an incredibly detailed outline regarding rabbit health and care following our appointment.
It’s the best place for exotic pets. I have a bunny I’m registered with them. Everytime I go in there I’m always welcomed with a smile. Vets are really detailed and helpful. Highly recommend.
I’ve been here a long time, through many vets and many pets. Staff are helpful and responsive. Thanks Greenwood Animal Clinic!

I love Greenwood Park.  Hands down the best vet care we've had in our decades of pet ownership.  Top notch service, compassionate, and extremely caring for all our pets (from critters to big dogs).  Greenwood Park has gone above and beyond for our family on many occasions.  We are very grateful to have such a wonder Animal Hospital in our neighbourhood.

Outstanding Veterinary Care!
As a dog trainer specializing in reactive behavior, I often work with dogs that require extra patience and understanding. One of my board-and-train dogs from a rescue needed sedation for grooming and general care. The entire team at this clinic went above and beyond to support us. The vet was very involved and they not only provided exceptional care with compassion and professionalism, but they don't over charge like most other Toronto vet's. I can’t thank them enough for their dedication and kindness. Highly recommended!

By far the best vet clinic I’ve been too. The staff is always welcoming and the care for every animal that comes in is clear. Regardless of what health concern pops up, the team is helpful and knowledgeable! Dr. Amanda is the best and I always feel better knowing my ladies are in her care.

The team at Greenwood Park Animal Hospital are truly amazing and kind. I've taken my two kittens there several times for check-ups and kitten shots (these guys also came with ear mites and Giardia, lovely! And one of them got a small leg injury in the first couple weeks). I think I've met most of their vets and vet techs in the last month, and every one of them are kind and explain everything in detail, which is very reassuring for a new pet owner. They take their time with you and I've always left with the feeling that they deeply understand an owner's love and concern for their pet. My favourite vet was Dr. Melissa Herman - she took the time to explain my cat's x-ray results in such detail and seemed so knowledgeable and genuine -  but I believe she's only there temporarily, unfortunately! The front desk staff are friendly and patient, and great to chat with while you're waiting; they too seem to know a lot about animal care. They even contacted my pet insurance company for me and allowed me to wait in an exam room for pre-approval until doing further work. I think they felt a little bad for me and all the issues my kittens had early on, so gave me a discount on one ear cleaning and did the second one at no charge - just so kind.

Obviously I can't say enough about this incredible team and practice. It might be on the pricier side (likely due to its location in central Toronto), but no matter what, vet care is not cheap and you have to be prepared for that if you're going to take on the responsibility of caring for a pet. And, it's worth it for this level of care.
We really trust their advice for our dog

Saved my cockatiels life! Everyone there is very friendly and helpful. The vet that saw her was Dr Markus. He was very kind and explained everything in a very clear and easy way to understand , and gave me alot of helpful information.

I showed up about 40 minutes early and they managed to slip me in so I wasn't waiting too long.
Vet was super nice and confident and I felt comfortable having my pet seen by her.
Glad that there's an 'exotic' vet for us to go to. There are hardly any in Toronto.
They helped me saving my Comie the Syrian hamster 🐹✨ Every one is kind and considerate as well. …

My experience at Greenwood Animal Park Hospital is always very positive one. From the front desk staff to the vet techs and my amazing veterinarian (Dr. Amanda Marsella)! Thank you for providing amazing care to my cats and always taking the time to answer any and all my questions! I highly recommend this team!

We have been travelling, from Niagara, once a week since Dec to bring our Standard Poodle to Dr. Markus.  He has the experience, that our local vet did not, for a very nasty six month ear infection. Very grateful for Dr. Markus and his staff for the guidance and care for our fur baby.

Accepted us without appointment with our emergency case, friendly and compassionate staff, Dr. Markus Luckwaldt explained everything in simple words, medications work and my hamster is feeling much better. Definitely recommend this clinic.

Thanks so much for checking Hamlet and putting my mind at ease. He's just a silly, floofy old man and fire alarms are apparently his new nemesis. LOL All questions were answered, pain meds did the trick for his arthritis and he got back to normal by the end of the following day, so no further concerns. I really appreciate your squeezing me in for that appointment on short notice. Seeing how much care and concern is lavished on my piggies during every visit just makes me love you guys more. I recommend you all the time. Always a pleasure to come in and see everyone.

A wonderful clinic! From the receptionists to the technicians to the vets this clinic over delivers in service, value and kindness and understanding as well. Despite being a busy clinic I have never felt rushed through consults or treatments and have found  the  entire veterinary team to be very focused and supportive no matter what the situation is  with my pets and I always leave feeling my let’s have had the best care and treatment. Five stars all around😃

Dr Luckwaldt is the BESTEST VET!  He is sincere, honest, and just a great human being! My Murphy, (dog), love's him! He knows when he leaves there, that he will feel so much better than when he got there. Just a great environment and awesome staff! I give a 10 outta 10 for everything! 😉 …
My dogs love going here, with great staff and service no wonder.
I will recommend this clinic to all my friends who have pets due to their great service, caring staff and professionalism in dealing with the health of your pet. Thank you.

I love Greenwood Animal Hospital for both my dogs. Marcus is the BEST VET ANYWHERE! Love this man . Nice to see Kenner still at the front after all these years . Piper and Porter always feel so special when we come there. The folks here make us all feel so welcome. Thank you to Marcus and his amazing team! You all are AMAZING!!!!

I personally cannot say enough good things about this place. From the friendly staff, to our current vet, Dr. Luckwaldt, we have had an amazing experience. One of our birds were sick and Dr Markus did everything to save him, even reaching out to international vets and gathering a solution for the little birdie. 6 months later, our little boy has fully recovered, and this clinic has earned lifelong customers, trusting them with our whole flock. Initially we were hesitant, but felt reassured by our choice when the avian expert at the Toronto Zoo also recommended him.

Great spot if you’re looking to get care for your bearded dragon! ​Dr. Markus Luckwaldt is incredibly knowledgable, I could tell right away he knew exactly what to do for my situation. It’s very clear his years of experience has made him a great vet for a wide variety of animals! The reception (especially Karley) and vet technicians were also amazing, answering all my anxious questions even though they were endless. Thank you to the Greenwood Park Animal Hospital team!

I have had many animals over the years and I only recently found GreenPark Animal Hospital... I wish I had found them sooner. They are about you and your animal before they are about profit - and that is RARE. Extremely helpful, compassionate, and respectful. They answer emails asap... and offer helpful suggestions without a visit scheduled. The front staff is lovely and welcoming, the vets and vet techs are humorous and very good natured. You can tell they care.
Great vets, great service. My dog is already improving.  Could not be happier with results
Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Dr. Marcus is great - makes his explanations easily understood for the lay person….always nice to be greeted by friendly faces
They accept rats! I asked so many hospitals, and they didn't accept rats. Greenwood really helped me and my rat a lot.

I felt very disconnected for the whole appointment time. They didn't examine my rabbit in my presence and made us wait in a room with the door closed for more than 10 minutes- rabbits are very easily frightened and don't like to be cooped up very long. Since my appt was 9:30 am and they were not busy, I had no idea what was taking so long. The Vet spoke in medical language and used terms I had never heard of before, and I had to ask her to please explain what she meant. I felt illiterate and I am not. As well, one of the receptionists was rude when I asked her about the price of the procedure, and I even heard her swear. For a first appointment, it was not great. I didn't feel the love or passion for animals at this clinic. I miss the old days of the Vet talking nicely and not trying to sound clinical and superior-and admiring your pet- showing the client that they love animals.  No one even told me my rabbit was beautiful- and he is! There aren't many places in Toronto to take your sick rabbit, so it leaves me very unsure. And yes, the price at the end of the appt was astronomical. Wow.

From all the clinics I've taken my rabbits to this has definitely been the best one.

All the staff are caring, attentive, and genuinely compassionate. From Emma at the front desk with her radiant personality that ensures everyone is assisted as soon as possible, to their vet tech for exotics Tara who is so caring with all pets and always pays great attention to all of our concerns.

Dr. Luckwaldt has also consistently gone above and beyond for the care of our rabbits and supported us through good and bad times.  His expertise with small animals is outstanding, and he always takes the time to thoroughly explain procedures and answer questions.

I highly recommend this clinic to any pet owner looking for knowledgeable and trustworthy veterinary care.
Best vet in the city! Amazing staff

I am OVERLY protective of my almost 12 year old precious pup, but I would highly recommend the SUPER kind and loving Amanda Marcella. She truly is a wonderful human. A BIG thank you to the wonderful, caring and loving Jem as well ❤️ What a great team they made for my boy. He wasn’t in a rush to leave after his appointment and that says it all !
They just asked $800 for spaying a rabbit this is double of most expensive one ($400) in the city  Keep up the rip
Our experience has been great, everyone is very friendly, accommodating, and knowledgeable, Barry loves going to the vet!

I am very pleased with my bunny’s care at Greenwood Park and their knowledgeable team. All staff have been professional and caring and always take the time to answer all my questions. They are highly recommended.
Great staff!
Very caring and knowledgeable staff. They did my bunny’s neutering and could not have gone better! They were fantastic and explained everything to me.

We took our puppy Elsa to this clinic a month ago for her first appointment. From the start, the experience was disappointing. The vet who saw us couldn't answer basic questions, like the recommended age to spay an Airedale Terrier, which made us lose trust. Additionally, the staff’s attitude in general was like they're doing us a favor, though that might be subjective.

During the visit, they vaccinated and examined our puppy, which cost us almost $500. At the end, they told us that when we returned for the booster shots, we wouldn't have to pay for another consultation. However, when we tried to schedule the appointment, we were told the vet wasn’t available, and they couldn’t tell us when he would return. They offered to have another vet give the boosters, but it would mean paying for another consultation and exam ($150+ tax). We decided to wait a few weeks for the vet to come back, but when we called again, they said he had returned, but since more than a month had passed, they had to examine her again and charge for the consultation.

We find this practice abusive and opportunistic, assuming that everyone in the area has high purchasing power. We will not be returning to this clinic.
